name: Sbu Lift

replaces.name: Hevy - Workout Tracker Gym Log
replaces.price_model: Freemium: free tier with caps (routines, custom exercises, graph history); Hevy Pro monthly/yearly/lifetime subscription. IAP prices not in the lookup data.

replaces.name: Lyfta: Gym Workout Tracker Log
replaces.price_model: Freemium advertised as free; Lyfta Pro 14-day trial then ~60 USD/year per reviews, required at the end of sign-up per several reviews

one_thing: Logs the sets you lift and shows if you are getting stronger.

features.name: Workout logging
features.description: Start empty or from a routine; per exercise a set table with previous values, weight and reps, set type (warm-up, normal, drop, failure), supersets, optional RPE and note; tap to complete a set.
features.reason: What every Hevy user does in the gym; free in Hevy but the base of all Pro features.

features.name: Unlimited routines
features.description: Create, reorder and folder routines without limit; duplicate a routine.
features.reason: Hevy Pro: 'Create unlimited routines' (free tier capped at 4 per reviews).

features.name: Unlimited custom exercises
features.description: Add exercises with name, primary/secondary muscle, equipment and kind (weight+reps, bodyweight reps, duration, distance+duration).
features.reason: Hevy Pro: 'Create unlimited custom exercises'.

features.name: Full progress history
features.description: Per exercise: Swift Charts of best weight, estimated 1RM, session volume and total reps over the whole history; personal records list.
features.reason: Hevy Pro: 'unlimited access to graph history'.

features.name: Body measurements
features.description: Body weight and tape measurements over time with a chart; weight read from/written to Apple Health if allowed.
features.reason: Hevy Pro: 'Track advanced measurements'.

features.name: Rest timer
features.description: Per-exercise default rest that starts when a set is completed; +/-15 s; haptic and a time-sensitive local notification when it ends, Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
features.reason: Hevy core; Lyfta reviewer: rest notification does not vibrate.

features.name: One-rep max estimate
features.description: Estimated 1RM per set (Epley/Brzycki shown by name) and a calculator.
features.reason: Listed in Hevy and Lyfta.

features.name: Workout calendar and history
features.description: Calendar of trained days and a List of past workouts with duration, volume and sets; edit or delete a past workout.
features.reason: Hevy core.

features.name: Bundled exercise list
features.description: About 200 exercises written by Sbu (IT/EN names, primary/secondary muscle with sub-regions such as upper chest and triceps heads, equipment, kind, unilateral flag), shipped in the app as JSON; no images or videos, SF Symbols per category. No wger data.
features.reason: Needed offline from the first launch. wger's exercise data is Creative Commons per entry (CC-BY-SA family) and its code is AGPL-3.0: not MIT/Apache, so not used.

features.name: Autosave every set
features.description: Every change is saved immediately to SwiftData; a workout in progress survives app kill, crash or reboot and resumes on launch.
features.reason: Pain: workouts, routines or previous weights lost (5).

features.name: Timed and distance sets
features.description: Duration and distance+duration exercises with a countdown for the active phase (sound off, haptic and notification), which then starts the rest timer automatically.
features.reason: Pain: cardio/timed exercises tracked like reps, no countdown (3).

features.name: Left and right sides
features.description: Unilateral exercises log left and right reps/weight separately in the same set.
features.reason: Pain: cannot log left and right separately (1).

features.name: Add any exercise mid-workout
features.description: During a workout add any exercise or another routine's exercises without leaving the session.
features.reason: Pain: cannot add exercises from another routine during a workout (1).

features.name: Export and import
features.description: Export workouts, routines and custom exercises as JSON and workouts as CSV; import the JSON back.
features.reason: Pain: no export (1) and data loss (5); also the exit door users ask for.

features.name: Apple Health workout export
features.description: Save each finished workout to Health as a traditional strength training HKWorkout with start, end and duration; active energy only if the user enables it, and never when an Apple Watch workout overlaps the same interval.
features.reason: Pain: calories double-counted in Apple Health (1). Hevy exports to Health too.

features.name: iCloud sync of routines and exercises
features.description: Optional, off by default (ADR-0008): routines and custom exercises sync through the user's private CloudKit database; workouts, body measurements and anything from HealthKit stay on device.
features.reason: Second device convenience within 5.1.3(ii).

features.name: Live workout session on iPhone
features.description: On iOS 26 run an HKWorkoutSession on iPhone for live heart rate from paired sensors; iOS 17-25 fall back to saving the finished workout with HKWorkoutBuilder.
features.reason: Nice to have; only iOS 26 has the iPhone workout session.

features.name: System countdown for rest
features.description: On iOS 26 the rest timer can use AlarmKit so it alerts in silent mode and Focus; iOS 17-25 keep the time-sensitive notification.
features.reason: Addresses silent-mode misses; must be user-started and explained (AlarmKit permission).

features.name: Plate calculator
features.description: Plates per side for a target weight and bar, kg or lb.
features.reason: Common gym helper, pure arithmetic.

features.name: Widget and Start routine intent
features.description: Widget with the last workout and an App Intent 'Inizia allenamento' for Shortcuts/Siri.
features.reason: Hevy has widgets; WidgetKit/App Intents iOS 17.

screens.name: Allenamento
screens.purpose: Home: start a workout; the one figure.
elements: one figure: workouts this week (or days since the last), SbuStat closed by the full stop

screens.name: Workout in progress
screens.purpose: Log sets fast with gloves-on targets.
elements: elapsed time and volume in statSmall
per exercise: set table (Precedente, kg, Ripetizioni, done check), set type menu, L/R columns for unilateral

screens.name: Routine editor
elements: exercise list with target sets/reps/rest, reorder, superset grouping

screens.name: Esercizi
elements: List with SF Symbol per category

screens.name: Esercizio (detail)
elements: chart picker: carico massimo, 1RM stimato, volume, ripetizioni

screens.name: Storico
elements: List of workouts with duration, volume, sets

data_model.storage: SwiftData on device, saved on every change. Bundled exercise list as a JSON resource written by Sbu. Optional iCloud (ADR-0008, off by default) only for Routine and custom Exercise; Workout, WorkoutSet and BodyMeasurement never leave the device except via user export or Apple Health (5.1.3(ii)).

monetization.model: Freemium. Hevy is free with caps; Hevy Pro removes them. Lyfta advertises free but asks for Pro (14-day trial) at the end of sign-up.
monetization.price: Hevy Pro: monthly, yearly and lifetime IAP (amounts not in the lookup data). Lyfta Pro ~60 USD/year per reviews (us#2, us#6).
paywalled_features: (Lyfta) advanced analytics, expert programs, progression tools
monetization.notes: Hevy's free tier is generous, so its 1-3 star reviews are few (8); most pains come from Lyfta (26). Hevy's social feed and exercise videos need accounts and licensed media and are skipped.

pains.pain: Advertised as free, subscription demanded after onboarding; unwanted charges
Exercise library: duplicates, poor or offensive names, missing exercises
pains.evidence: 'multiple of the same looking exercises'; 'Libreria scarsa'

pains.pain: Workouts, routines or previous weights lost or not saved
pains.evidence: 'Returned to the app being refreshed and lost program'

pains.pain: Time-based and cardio exercises tracked like reps; no countdown
pains.evidence: 'it tracks cardio the same way as weights in terms of reps and sets'

pains.pain: Account and sign-up required before use
pains.evidence: 'As soon as you create a login... you're required to start a subscription'

pains.pain: No Garmin or Huawei wearable support
pains.becomes: skip: vendor SDKs and clouds (network, third-party code)

pains.pain: Muscle groups too coarse (upper/lower chest, triceps heads)
Exercises or workouts do not load
pains.evidence: 'da 2 mesi che non si caricano gli esercizi'

pains.pain: Apple Watch connection problems or dropped support
pains.evidence: 'constant connection issues between iPhone and Apple Watch'
pains.becomes: skip: no watchOS app in v1; the iPhone app works alone

pains.pain: Rest timer notification does not vibrate
pains.evidence: 'Rest timer notifications are not vibrating, just the sound'

pains.pain: Progress photo cannot be saved back
pains.evidence: 'once you upload it you don't have a way to download it'
pains.becomes: skip: progress photos are not the one thing; the Photos app keeps them

pains.pain: No export of workouts and routines (JSON)

pains.evidence: 'il limite di 4 schede massimo... per la versione gratuita'

pains.pain: Cannot log left and right side separately
pains.evidence: 'inserire la destra e la sinistra nelle serie'

pains.pain: Cannot add an exercise from another routine during a workout
pains.evidence: 'preclude la possibilità di segnare esercizi inseriti in altre schede'
'my active calories in the Fitness app is doubled'

skipped.feature: Social feed, following friends, copying their workouts, public profile

skipped.reason: Licensed media or network; SF Symbols per category and a short text cue instead.
Code AGPL-3.0, exercise data and images under per-entry Creative Commons (CC-BY-SA family): not MIT/Apache, so not a dependency. Sbu writes its own list.
Third-party program names/trademarks and editorial content; users build their own routines.
Out of v1 scope; Live Activity covers the wrist via notifications.
Server or medical-ish advice; out of scope.

review_risks.risk: Workout loggers are a crowded category and the account already had six 4.3 rejections.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes: no caps, no account, autosave, timed/unilateral sets, own exercise list; difference from Sbu Steps and other Sbu apps; submit alone.

review_risks.risk: Hevy's set table and layout are distinctive.
review_risks.mitigation: Native Form/List in Sbu paper design, own copy and icon; no Hevy wording.

review_risks.risk: Syncing workouts, body weight or HealthKit-derived data to iCloud.
review_risks.mitigation: Sync limited to routines and custom exercises in a separate CloudKit store; workouts and measurements local only.

review_risks.risk: HealthKit entitlement must serve fitness and be visible in UI; data not used otherwise.
review_risks.mitigation: Apple Salute toggle explaining workouts and body weight; usage strings IT/EN; privacy policy.

review_risks.risk: New Health & Fitness app must answer the declaration.
review_risks.mitigation: Declare not a medical device; no injury, rehab or health-outcome claims; 1RM labelled as estimate.

review_risks.risk: Named commercial programs or copied exercise descriptions/images.
review_risks.mitigation: Self-written generic exercise names and muscles; no named programs; no third-party media.

review_risks.risk: Alarm permission asked without a clear user action.
review_risks.mitigation: Only behind a 'Avviso anche in silenzioso' toggle, asked on enable; P2.

source.reviews: research/lift/reviews.json (34 reviews 1-3 stars, US+IT: Hevy 8, Lyfta 26, classified by hand)
